scope: Strict 6 Hyperlink Functions Implementation & OpenXML Binding

tasks.title: Build Core Hyperlink Subsystem & OpenXML Relationship Infrastructure
tasks.description: Create src/managers/HyperlinkManager.js and wire it to PPTXTemplater. Implement OpenXML relationship mechanics in ppt/slides/_rels/slideN.xml.rels for external URL targets (r:id binding with Type='http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/hyperlink' and TargetMode='External') as well as internal slide targets (ppaction://hlinksldjump or target slide relationship references). Handle non-visual shape drawing properties (<p:cNvPr><a:hlinkClick>) and text run properties (<a:rPr><a:hlinkClick>).

tasks.title: Implement Target-Level Hyperlink APIs (addHyperlink, updateHyperlink, removeHyperlink)
tasks.description: Implement addHyperlink(targetId, url, options), updateHyperlink(targetId, url, options), and removeHyperlink(targetId) to bind, modify, or detach hyperlinks from entire shapes, text boxes, images, and other slide objects via <a:hlinkClick> in <p:cNvPr>. Handle tooltip options, action behaviors, URL sanitization, and purging of orphaned relationship entries in slide .rels files upon removal.

tasks.title: Implement Hyperlink Inspection APIs (getHyperlinks & getHyperlink)
tasks.description: Implement getHyperlinks(slideId) and getHyperlink(targetId) to parse slide XML and relationship mappings in read-only mode. Extract target identifiers, destination URLs or internal slide indices, action types, tooltips, target element types (shape, text run, image), and associated styles without modifying the underlying DOM/AST.

tasks.title: Implement Substring Text Hyperlink & Styling API (setHyperlink)
tasks.description: Implement setHyperlink(targetId, text, url, options) to locate a specific text substring inside a shape/textbox, perform AST run splitting/healing (<a:r>/<a:t>) to isolate only the target text, attach <a:hlinkClick> to the split run's <a:rPr>, and apply custom typographic/hyperlink styling options (e.g., color, underline, bold, italic).

tasks.title: Comprehensive Showcase Script (showcase/hyperlinks_advanced.js)
tasks.description: Create showcase/hyperlinks_advanced.js demonstrating all 6 Hyperlink methods (external web URLs, internal slide jumps, tooltips, shape links, text substring link styling, hyperlink queries, updates, and removals). Include clear console diagnostics, inline JSDoc comments, and ensure generated presentations open error-free in PowerPoint.

tasks.title: Synchronize Documentation, TypeScript Declarations & .agent Memory
tasks.description: Update index.d.ts with complete parameter typings for all 6 Hyperlink functions. Sync docs-site/src/data/apiReference.json, docs-site/src/data/features.json, README.md, and .agent memory files (.agent/rules/features.md, .agent/project_summary.md) to document the Hyperlink category and its exact API signatures.
